keynums.label: Coverage
keynums.value: 53 Cities (Tier 1: 14 cities; Tier 2: 39 cities) - a separate panel states "50+ Cities"

bull_bear.body:
- A six-year metrics table (in Rs. Cr) shows a "Free Cash" line of 21.08 (FY21), 62.15 (FY22), 59.64 (FY23), 68.54 (FY24), 82.29 (FY25) and 96.17 (FY26); the accompanying chart is titled "Free Cash Growth (356%)".
- The deck states that "PropEquity's other income is the Interest Earned on Fixed Deposits and Dividends which will continue for the foreseeable future", indicating a cash/fixed-deposit-heavy balance sheet.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Describes a "Spectrum of Services & Platforms" offering "Integrated intelligence, advisory, and capital solutions across the real estate value chain", spanning a real-time data analytics platform, research & consulting, retail valuations, capital markets/investment banking, project monitoring & land loan verification, project approval (APF sourcing) and lead generation.
- Clientele of "300+ Clients (81% Retention)" drawn from Private Equity Funds, Real Estate Developers, Banks, Financial Institutions, Education, Construction Industry, NBFCs and Mortgage Lenders.
- Claims "Every quarter has seen a positive growth since our IPO in April 2022".
- Positions PropEquity AI as "The First ChatGPT of Real Estate".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Subsidiary] PropEdge is disclosed as "(Our Subsidiary)", reported on a standalone basis for Valuation and Professional services alongside standalone PropEquity and a consolidated view.
- [Listing] The company is listed on NSE under the symbol PROPEQUITY and the deck references its IPO in April 2022.
- [Leadership] Samir Jasuja is named as MD & CEO (Managing Director, DIN 01681776).
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions P.E. Analytics Limited (PropEquity) as a real estate data-analytics and research house whose platform, valuation/CRM and advisory services span the real estate value chain, with the MD describing it as "a leader in real estate data and analytics, consistently driving innovation to empower data-backed decision-making."
